Charlotte County, Virginia Tax Sales: A Comprehensive Guide

Interested in participating in tax sales in Charlotte County, Virginia? This guide provides a clear overview of the process, including scheduling, registration, bidding procedures, and contact information.​

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

Understanding Tax Sales in Charlotte County

Tax sales in Charlotte County are conducted to recover unpaid property taxes by auctioning delinquent properties to the public. These sales occur as needed, without a fixed annual schedule. To stay informed about upcoming auctions, regularly check the county’s Auction Calendar.​TACS+1TACS+1

Auction Details

  • Timing: Auctions typically begin at 1:00 PM Eastern Time. Always refer to the official auction announcement for the exact date and time.​
  • Location: Sales are usually held at the Charlotte County Circuit Courthouse, located at 145 David Bruce Avenue, Charlotte Court House, VA 23923. Confirm the venue in the specific auction notice.​TACS+1Charlotte County+1

Registration Requirements

To participate in a tax sale, you must register in advance. Registration periods vary for each auction, so it’s crucial to review the official auction notice for specific registration deadlines and procedures.​

Bidding Process and Payment Terms

  • Bidding: Properties are sold to the highest bidder. Detailed bidding instructions are provided in the auction notice.​
  • Deposits and Payments:
    • A deposit is required immediately after winning a bid.​
    • The remaining balance, along with a buyer’s premium and deed recording costs, must be paid within seven days following the auction closing.​TACS+1TACS+1
    • Accepted payment methods include certified funds, cashier’s checks, money orders, or wire transfers. Personal checks and cash are not accepted.​TACS+1TACS+1

All properties are sold “as-is,” without any warranties. Conduct thorough due diligence before bidding. For more details on payment terms, refer to the Charlotte County Real Estate Tax Sale page.​TACS+1TACS+1

Property Redemption

Property owners have the right to redeem their property by paying all outstanding taxes, penalties, interest, and associated costs at any time before the auction.​

Additional Information and Contacts

  • Charlotte County Treasurer’s Office:
    • Email: pberkeley@charlottecountyva.gov​
    • Phone: (434) 542-5125​
    • Address: 201 David Bruce Avenue, Charlotte Court House, VA 23923​Charlotte County+1TACS+1
  • Taxing Authority Consulting Services (TACS):
    • Email: taxsales@taxva.com​
    • Phone: (804) 612-0629​
    • Address: P.O. Box 31800, Henrico, VA 23294-1800​TACS+1TACS+1

For the latest updates on tax sales and detailed property listings, visit the Charlotte County Real Estate Tax Sale page.​TACS+1TACS+1
